无所不度（无所不度（第22页）天有三魂指代一曰胎光，太清阳和之气也；二为爽灵，阴气之变也；三为幽精，阴气之杂也。二景含晶，乃是阴阳流转、日月星辰；天有七魄为天冲、灵慧、气、力、中枢、精与英。简单来说就是，推正七星轨度统摄天地之力，聚合为一、七星垂光，无所不度、万灵振伏。七星度厄、宣威三界法周元旧不施展，却没想到还能提升。如此一来，再见曾经的子四之佛、如今的自然生灭佛时，可以反驳‘只会拿三宝如意敲人’的说法了。“三宝道君，可有所获？”“正要说与七位道君听，推正七星、轨度正序，道入其中、无所不成。”“大善，道君果然聪慧，我刚讲法你便领悟其中真意，再布七星度厄。依照约定，我当授你卷三十七、七星除妖品，助你加固自身道途、早成无量度人经。”斗斋七星宫是道门杀才，七星除妖品更是无所不度法。诚然七星度厄无三宝如意那般周全，但他将杀伐之力发挥到了极限。其贵在聚合、只度一人，甚至自身之力还不够，要用七处天地来增威。周元都不敢想，若以三洞真经调度众道之力，七星度厄法调用七界之力，再附加他自身的道途与五太聚变，能打出何等伤害。“三蛋奇辉真仗义，混沌黑蛋竟然愿意让我借用其力来布道。不过灵幻天是怎么回事，为何变得如此可靠了？”

There are three souls in the sky. One is embryonic light, which is the qi of Taiqing Yang and Harmony; the other is Shuangling, which is the change of yin qi; the third is secluded essence, which is the mixture of yin qi. The second scene contains crystals, which are The flow of yin and yang, the sun, the moon and the stars; there are seven souls in the sky, namely Tianchong, Linghui, Qi, Li, Center, Jing and Ying. To put it simply, the power of correcting the orbits of the seven stars to govern the heaven and earth is gathered into one, and the seven stars shine down, and there is nothing. If you don't save, all the spirits will be subdued. Zhou Yuan has not used the Seven Stars to save evil and Xuanwei in the Three Realms, but he didn't expect it to improve. In this way, when we see the Buddha of Zisi and the current Buddha of Natural Creation and Death, we can refute the saying that he only uses the Three Treasures to hit people as he wishes. Taoist Lord is really smart. You understood the true meaning of it as soon as I taught the Dharma. According to the agreement, I will give you the thirty-seventh volume and the seven-star demon-killing product to help you strengthen your path and become an immeasurable human being. "The Seven Star Palace of Douzhai is the Taoist killer, and the Seven Star Demon Exorcist is all-encompassing. It is true that the Seven Stars are not as comprehensive as the Three Treasures in preventing evil, but he has brought his killing power to the limit. Its value lies in gathering and only saving. One person, even if his own power is not enough, has to use the seven worlds to increase his power. Zhou Yuan can't imagine how much damage he can do if he uses the three-hole scripture to mobilize the power of the seven realms, plus his own path and the fusion of the five elements. "Sandan Qihui is so righteous, and Chaos Black Egg is willing to let me borrow his power to preach. But what happened to Linghuan Tian, and why has it become so reliable?"
